title: Brand Marketing Assistant
description:
Hiring due to a period of extended growth

Would you be excited by the opportunity to work with an internationally recognised premium brand within a global marketing team?

The role would suit an organised and creative individual with previous experience within Marketing, who is looking to develop their career within a global brand environment.

You will support a wide range of activities including content creation, product launches, trade shows, market research and international marketing campaigns.

The successful candidate will have excellent attention to detail, strong organisational skills and a proactive, can-do approach. Practical Adobe InDesign experience is essential, with Photoshop, HubSpot or content management experience highly desirable.

Job Type: Full-time & Permanent

Job Title: Brand Marketing Assistant

Salary: 28,000 to 30,000

Hours: 40 hours per week

Location: Guildford - One day a week from home.

Brand Marketing Assistant Responsibilities:
- Managing marketing assets including brochures, specification sheets, photography, video and sales tools
- Updating marketing literature using Adobe InDesign, following approved templates and brand guidelines
- Coordinating literature updates, translations and publication across relevant websites and marketing portals
- Managing document control and ensuring internal teams and distributors have access to the latest materials
- Supporting marketing campaigns, product launches, trade shows and events
- Responding to routine marketing enquiries and coordinating regional requests
- Liaising with agencies, suppliers and translation providers when required
- Monitoring market research, industry news and competitor activity to identify relevant insights and trends
- Working closely with Marketing, Sales, Product Management, Culinary and Aftersales teams

Brand Marketing Assistant Desirable Skills:
- Previous experience within Marketing, Communications, Design, Sales Support or a similar environment
- Practical Adobe InDesign experience is essential, including editing templates and preparing print-ready PDFs
- Excellent attention to detail, proofreading and file-management skills
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines
- Good written and verbal communication skills
- Good knowledge of Microsoft 365, particularly Outlook, Word, PowerPoint and Excel
- Experience with content management systems, digital asset platforms or marketing portals
- Photoshop and HubSpot/CRM experience would be beneficial
- Experience within Engineering, Manufacturing or another technical environment would be desirable
- A proactive, flexible and collaborative approach to work

title: CRM & Partnerships Executive
description:
Excellent Benefits

Hybrid Working - 3 Days in the Office

Klaviyo knowledge an advantage!

12 Month contract - Immediate start!

We are recruiting for an exciting CRM & Partnerships Executive opportunity with a successful and growing consumer-focused business.

Working closely with the Senior Digital Marketing Manager, you will support the delivery of customer email campaigns, automated journeys and CRM activity, while also taking responsibility for affiliate and external partnership relationships.

This is a varied role combining CRM, email marketing, affiliate marketing, partnerships and campaign analysis, making it an excellent opportunity for someone looking to develop their career within a fast-paced digital marketing environment.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage email marketing campaigns from initial planning through to delivery, testing and performance analysis.
- Support the development of CRM strategies designed to increase customer engagement, retention and repeat purchasing.
- Create and manage automated customer journeys including welcome, re-engagement, abandoned browse and abandoned basket campaigns.
- Develop customer segmentation strategies using behavioural, transactional and engagement data.
- Build targeted customer audiences to deliver relevant and personalised communications.
- Carry out regular A/B testing to improve email and campaign performance.
- Work closely with internal teams including Buying, Merchandising, Design, Customer Service and eCommerce.
- Analyse campaign performance and provide clear reporting and recommendations.
- Monitor key CRM measures including engagement, conversion, revenue, customer retention and ROI.
- Manage day-to-day relationships with affiliate partners and external agencies.
- Identify and onboard new affiliate and commercial partners.
- Support the negotiation and management of affiliate commission structures.
- Develop promotional opportunities and incentives for affiliate partners.
- Coordinate promotional assets, product information and campaign materials.
- Review affiliate performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
- Monitor key performance indicators including revenue, traffic, conversion, CPA, ROAS and average order value.
- Support partnership and retail media campaigns with external suppliers and brands.
- Coordinate partnership activity from initial agreement through to campaign delivery and post-campaign analysis.
- Build strong relationships with external partners and identify opportunities for collaborative marketing activity.

The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone with:
- Previous experience using a CRM or email marketing platform.
- Experience within digital marketing, CRM, eCommerce or affiliate marketing.
- An understanding of email campaigns, segmentation and automated customer journeys.
- Strong analytical skills and confidence interpreting campaign performance.
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
- A commercially focused approach with an understanding of ROI and performance.
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
- The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities within a fast-paced environment.
- Strong problem-solving skills.
- Confidence communicating results and recommendations to stakeholders.

Klaviyo knowledge an advantage!

12 Month contract - Immediate start!

If your application is successful, you will be contact shortly.

title: Digital Marketing Coordinator
description:
After clicking Apply, you'll be invited to create a profile on the Via website to complete your application. This doesn't guarantee you'll be matched to this specific role - Via reviews every application (AI first, then a human checks the fit) and shortlists the right candidates. Your profile also stays active for other relevant roles on the platform, and stays anonymous until you match. It takes just a few minutes.

Salary: £35,000-£42,000 per year

Working arrangement: Hybrid

Start date: Flexible

Full-time Permanent

About the opportunity

Via is partnering with a leading UK housebuilder looking for a Digital Marketing Coordinator to support its digital campaigns, website, content and customer journey.

Working closely with the Head of Digital, you'll help deliver marketing activity across email, PPC, SEO, display advertising, property portals and the company website.

It's a varied role that combines hands-on digital marketing with performance analysis. You'll help keep online content accurate and engaging, support campaigns designed to generate new customer enquiries and use performance data to identify opportunities to improve results.

Previous property or housebuilding experience would be useful but isn't essential. We're more interested in candidates with a good foundation in digital marketing who are comfortable working across several channels and want to develop their skills further.

What you'll be doing
- Coordinate digital marketing campaigns across email, PPC, SEO, display and other channels
- Support listings and campaigns across property portals such as Rightmove
- Help create, schedule and deliver customer email and lifecycle campaigns
- Support marketing automation activity
- Monitor campaigns against agreed KPIs and identify opportunities to improve performance
- Carry out keyword research and support SEO activity
- Make on-page SEO and content improvements
- Maintain and update website content through a CMS
- Ensure online content, imagery and information remain accurate and up to date
- Work with sales teams to maintain property and development information
- Help improve the online customer journey and website user experience
- Support the development and testing of new digital features and tools
- Track website and campaign performance
- Monitor traffic, engagement, conversion rates and cost per lead
- Use Google Analytics, Looker Studio, HubSpot and Excel to analyse performance
- Help produce monthly reports for sales teams and senior stakeholders
- Turn performance data into practical recommendations
- Work with internal teams and external partners on digital projects
- Ensure digital content remains consistent with brand standards
- Support the Head of Digital and wider marketing team with additional projects

What we're looking for
- Previous experience in digital marketing or a broader marketing role with strong digital exposure
- Good understanding of digital marketing fundamentals
- Experience working across multiple digital marketing channels
- Familiarity with website CMS platforms
- Understanding of email marketing and marketing automation
- Familiarity with PPC and digital advertising
- Understanding of SEO principles
- Comfortable working with digital marketing data and performance metrics
- Experience with Google Analytics or similar analytics tools
- Strong Excel skills
- Understanding of the online customer journey and conversion
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Excellent attention to detail
- Good organisation and the ability to manage several priorities at once
- Analytical and curious approach to marketing performance
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment
- Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills
- Proactive approach and willingness to learn

Experience with HubSpot, Looker Studio, property portals or similar tools would be particularly useful.

Previous experience within housebuilding, property, real estate or another consumer sector with a considered customer journey would be an advantage, but isn't essential.

A marketing, digital, business or related degree would be useful, although equivalent practical experience will also be considered.

Why apply?
- £35,000-£42,000 salary
- Company bonus scheme
- Hybrid and flexible working opportunities
- 25 days' annual leave
- Private healthcare and cash plan options
- Private pension
- ShareSave scheme
- Cycle to work scheme
- Gym membership discounts
- Work across a broad range of digital marketing channels
- Exposure to PPC, SEO, email, CRM, analytics and website optimisation
- Opportunity to work closely with an experienced Head of Digital
- Strong scope for learning and professional development

If you're an early-career digital marketer looking for a varied role where you can build experience across campaigns, content, analytics and customer experience, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Marketing and Communications Manager
company: Rainbow Trust Children's Charity - Agency - Permanent
description:
Marketing and Communications Manager

Up to £40,000 + benefits (including 25 days annual leave and pension)

Leatherhead, Surrey

About the role:

We are looking to appoint an experienced Marketing and Communications Manager to lead and deliver marketing campaigns that will drive awareness of Rainbow Trust and support fundraising activity to strengthen our position as experts in children's palliative care. This is a broad and exciting role which includes creating, developing and delivering the brand campaigns and communication strategies.

Reporting to the Head of Marketing and Communications, you will take the lead on generating creative, engaging content and ideas for fundraising and brand awareness campaigns that drive increased targeted engagement to showcase our work, build on our organisational strategy and deliver our fundraising ambition.

What we're looking for:

An experienced marketing and communications manager - you have a motivational engaging style, who can draw out information and ideas of others

Lively and enthusiastic - you are outgoing, with a collaborative approach to achieving goals through knowledge-sharing and effective delegation. You are excellent at building rapport and developing good working relationships

A multi-tasker with a sense of urgency for goal achievement - you work at a faster than average pace, delegating effectively with thorough follow-up, and are quick to learn

An innovative, practical and creative problem-solver - you are a big picture thinker that responds quickly to varied activities and changing conditions. You will have experience in developing and delivering communication and media strategy

Applications will be particularly welcome from those in the charity/not-for-profit sector with a marketing, PR and communications background.

What we offer:

We're proud to be a Two-Star Best Companies Top 50 mid-sized organisation and a Top 10 Charity, and we're committed to creating a great place to work. You will benefit from:

Pension scheme where we contribute 5% of your salary and you contribute at least 3%.

A life assurance scheme for all employees which provides a death in service benefit of three times' basic pay.

Flexible working hours to balance home and working life.

25 days of annual leave plus public holidays - rising to 26 days after 1 year, 27 days after 5 years and 30 days after 11 years, with an additional 5 days to use in your 10th or 20th year of service (pro rata for part time).

The option to buy/sell annual leave, as well as additional leave for your birthday, wedding/civil ceremony and an extra half day off for Christmas shopping.

Time off in Lieu.

Employee Assistance Programme with access to remote GP, counselling, physiotherapy, resources to support your mental health and financial wellbeing, as well as a 24/7 helpline via

Family friendly policies, focused on employee wellbeing, and an active cross-organisational wellbeing group running a number of initiatives throughout the year.

Access to the Blue Light Card Scheme, and other rewards and discounts.

Bike to work, season ticket loan and payroll giving schemes.

A recommend a friend recruitment bonus scheme.

Robust training and development programmes to support your learning and growth.

If you'd like to find out more about these benefits and working with us, please visit our why work with us page.

More information about us and our recruitment process can be found in our Candidate Pack online.

About us:

Rainbow Trust Children's Charity enables families who have a child with a life-threatening or terminal illness to make the most of time together, providing expert, practical and emotional support, where they need it for as long as it is needed. For families living with childhood illness, time is everything. Right now, there are too many families coping alone with no support, no time to think, no time to make memories and no time for each other. We believe that no family should go through this alone, so we are here to change that.

How to apply:

To apply please send your CV and Covering letter to us via the link.

Closing date: - 9th November 2026

Interview dates: Interview dates to be confirmed

Your covering letter should highlight why your application should be considered above others and clearly state how your experience matches the essential criteria outlined in the Person Specification.

Please disclose in your covering letter if you have used AI for any part of your job application.

For a detailed job description please visit our website.

Interviews will take place at our Head Office in Leatherhead. We will only contact those applicants who have been successful. If you require any adjustments during the interview process, please let us know.

Early application is encouraged as we will review applications throughout the advertising period and reserve the right to close the advert early.

An enhanced DBS disclosure will be required for this post.

Rainbow Trust is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all employees to share this commitment.

Rainbow Trust is an equal opportunities employer and we welcome applications from all backgrounds.

title: Senior Communications & Marketing Officer
description:
Summary

Are you a creative storyteller? Do you like creating inspiring content across a range of platforms using different media? If so, we're looking for a Senior Communications and Marketing Officer to plan and lead our communications and marketing for Munstead Wood. This is an exciting time to join a new National Trust project, with the opportunity to shape and develop the storytelling for this special place from the very beginning.

Salary: £17,620.20 per annum pro rated (£29,367 FTE)

Contract Duration: Fixed term until 31st October 2028

Working Pattern: You will work 22.5 hours per week, with a flexible working pattern. Your hours may vary depending on operational requirements, but evening/weekend work will be rare. Where this is required, time off in lieu will be provided.

Interviews will be held on Monday 26th October at Munstead Wood

If you have any queries or would like to learn more about this role please email: .uk What it's like to work here

Munstead Wood is an exciting recent acquisition for the National Trust. The personal home of garden designer and prolific content creator Gertrude Jekyll, it was designed in collaboration with Edwin Lutyens.

Based at the property in Godalming, you'll be part of a small on-property team looking after the day-to-day needs and running of the property, which is not currently open to the public. There is also an active project team working through the design and planning phase, developing detailed proposals and fundraising to support this work. As part of the on-property team, you'll develop and support communications around this exciting and evolving project. You will need to be able to work regularly on-site.

What you'll be doing

You'll create a dynamic communications plan for this evolving project, leading the development and delivery of original content to support its key messages and themes across a range of communication channels. You'll bring fresh, creative ideas to life, telling the stories of this inspirational place of creativity in ways that connect with audiences around the world.

This is a dynamic and collaborative role, working with stakeholders from across the organisation and externally. You'll bring together diverse expertise to create high-quality content across multiple strands of activity, ensuring work is delivered efficiently and to a consistently high standard.

Who we're looking for

We'd love to hear from you if you have:
- experience creating captivating content using different media across all platforms, and for a range of audiences
- the ability to work collaboratively and flexibly, both independently and as part of a team
- experience building relationships and working with internal and external stakeholders
- experience building dynamic communications plans for evolving projects
- strong proof-reading skills

The package

The National Trust has the motto 'For everyone, for ever' at its heart. We're working hard to create an inclusive culture, where everyone feels they belong. It's important that our people reflect and represent the diversity of the communities and audiences we serve. We welcome and value difference, so when we say we're for everyone, we want everyone to be welcome in our teams too.
- Substantial pension scheme of up to 10% basic salary
- Free entry to National Trust places for you, a guest and your children (under 18)
- Rental deposit loan scheme
- Season ticket loan
- EV car lease scheme (for roles that meet the salary criteria)
- Perks at work discounts such as gym memberships, shopping discount codes, cinema discounts
- Holiday allowance up to 32 days relating to length of service, plus holiday purchase scheme, subject to meeting minimum criteria.
- Flexible working whenever possible
- Employee assistance programme
- Free parking at most Trust places
